1.web: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
1.asv: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.

2.web: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
2.asv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.

3.web: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
3.asv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

4.web: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
4.asv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.

5.web: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
5.asv: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. [Selah

6.web: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
6.asv: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

7.web: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
7.asv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, say they, doth hear?

8.web: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
8.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

9.web: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
9.asv: Because ofhis strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.

10.web: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
10.asv: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

11.web: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
11.asv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

12.web: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
12.asv: Forthe sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.

13.web: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
13.asv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth. [Selah

14.web: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
14.asv: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

15.web: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
15.asv: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.

16.web: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
16.asv: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.

17.web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
17.asv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
